dataModel.summary: A simple guide to preparing high-quality loose leaf or bagged tea.
dataModel.intro: A simple guide to preparing high-quality loose leaf or bagged tea.
dataModel.section_0_points:
• Use fresh, cold filtered water.
• Heat to the appropriate temperature for your tea type.
dataModel.section_1_points:
• Use 1 teaspoon of loose leaf tea per 8oz of water.
• Place tea in an infuser or teapot.
dataModel.section_2_points:
• Pour hot water over the leaves.
• Cover to retain heat and steep for the recommended time.
dataModel.section_3_points:
• Remove the infuser or strain the leaves immediately.
• Avoid over-steeping to prevent bitterness.
